messages:
Priya (Sales): Quick sync — AtlasAI wants a perf POC next week. They care about sustained 60 qps mixed (gen + embed) with p95 < 200ms and tail not > 500ms. Also asking for a cost projection if we need an extra 10% burst pool.
Ethan (Solutions): Copy. Are they running single-stream chat or batched embedding requests? that'll affect batching strategy.
Priya (Sales): Mixed: about 70% generation (short prompts, 40–80 tokens) and 30% embeddings (batch size 16 in their client). They also mentioned KMS w/ customer-managed keys and an HSM requirement in the security questionnaire.
Leo (SRE): KMS/HSM is doable on Dedicated but will increase lead time. For the POC we can demonstrate envelope encryption + our KMS integration; for full HSM we need 2–4 weeks for procurement and certs. Is that a blocker for the sales timeline?
Grace (Account Exec): They said initial POC can use our KMS but HSM is an enterprise requirement for the contract. We should show a migration path. Priya, confirm timeline.
Priya (Sales): POC window is 7 days starting Mon  — they want results before EOD Friday. They noted HSM as later but want the POC perf numbers to be production-like.
Ethan (Solutions): OK — here's a tentative load plan I propose:
```
- Duration: 45m ramps, 4h steady state, 30m soak
- Workload: mixed requests 60 qps sustained (gen:embed = 7:3)
- Gen params: max_tokens=80, temperature=0.0, stream=false
- Embedding: batch_size=16, parallelism=8
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, CPU/GPU util, kv-cache hit rate, token/s, error rate
- Fallback test: kill one replica mid-soak to measure graceful fallback
```
Can SRE advise instance sizing and any special routing?
Leo (SRE): For that mix I'd recommend 4x A10xm (or equivalent) in Dedicated during the steady window with autoscaling disabled to keep measurements stable. Use 1s KV cache TTL and enable prefix caching for gen. We'll pin model to v2.3-quant. Expect p95 ~120–180ms on short gen, embeddings p95 ~95–150ms depending on batch parallelism.
Priya (Sales): Sound good — also need cost estimate for that Dedicated footprint (4 GPUs, 8h total including ramps). Can you ballpark with our current pricing sheet?
Ethan (Solutions): Rough calc: our internal rate ~ $2.40/hour per A10xm reserved for dedicated POC. 4 GPUs * 8h * $2.40 ≈ $76.8 compute. Add storage/network ~ $12 and support/ops time ~ $150 (one-off run support) => ~ $239. Share as an indicative number; final invoice under reps.
Grace (Account Exec): I'll round to $250 in the quote and call out that burst capacity or HSM will add Opex/Capex.
ops-bot: deployment: perf-poc-atlasai started at 1700000150 by Ethan (Solutions) :rocket:
Ethan (Solutions): Running a dry run now with a synthetic mix. Attaching the run command for SRE: 
```
rally run --target https://api.redwood.example/predict \
  --concurrency 60 --duration 30m --mix gen:0.7,embed:0.3 \
  --embed-batch 16 --model redwood-model-v2.3-quant
```
Leo (SRE): Saw the run. Initial 30m dry run looks clean — avg GPU util ~72%, token/s stable, error rate 0.03%. Tail spikes at ~420ms during short GC on one node. We'll instrument GC pause times and adjust kernel selection.
Priya (Sales): AtlasAI exec wants a 1-slide summary after the run: key numbers (sustained qps, p95 gen, p95 embed, errors, cost). Can someone prep that?
Ethan (Solutions): I'll draft the slide and post screenshots of the realtime dashboard.
Leo (SRE): Postmortem notes for the main run: one node hit a driver bug causing a 300–400ms tail spike under a memory compaction -> mitigation applied (kernel pin + restart). After mitigation p99 improved from 680ms -> 240ms.
Grace (Account Exec): Great detail. Priya: iterate the quote to include a note about HSM lead time and possible one-time integration fee.
Priya (Sales): Will do. Thanks all — I'll update AtlasAI that POC is in progress and share estimated completed run timestamp (~1700000300). :thumbsup:
